module_summary: 64-bit 10GBASE-R 64b/66b encoder: per-lane control-code translation feeds a block-type mux keyed on xgmii_txc, registered into data, sync header and bad-block flag.

anchors.name: xgmii_txd
anchors.why: XGMII transmit data lanes; passed through or translated into control codes.

anchors.name: xgmii_txc
anchors.why: Per-lane control mask selecting data block versus block-type format.

anchors.name: encoded_ctrl
anchors.why: Per-lane 7-bit control codes translated from XGMII control characters.

anchors.name: encode_err
anchors.why: Per-lane invalid control character flags feeding bad-block detection.

anchors.name: encoded_tx_data_reg
anchors.why: Registered 64-bit encoded block payload output each cycle.

anchors.name: encoded_tx_hdr_reg
anchors.why: Registered 2-bit sync header: data or control block.

anchors.name: tx_bad_block_reg
anchors.why: Registered flag indicating input had no valid block encoding.

groups.name: Control code translator
groups.description: Maps each XGMII control character lane to 10GBASE-R 7-bit code.

groups.name: Block formatter
groups.description: Chooses block type from txc pattern and assembles 64-bit payload.

groups.name: Output registers
groups.description: Register encoded data, header and bad-block status.
